When darkness came, he lit the beacon and watched its patient beam cross the sea, carrying an answer no one might ever read.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时停机的机器。高架桥上偶尔掠过一辆出租车，车灯把潮湿的路面照成两条淡河。便利店仍亮着，店员伏在柜台后打盹，咖啡机发出轻微的响声。写字楼的玻璃窗映着稀薄的云，只有几层还亮着灯。清洁车慢慢驶过，扫帚拖出沙沙声。风从巷口吹来，带着早餐铺尚未点火的面粉味。远处地铁开始试跑，城市在铁轨的震动里，悄悄醒来。","w03":"• Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by asking itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\n• It must have a stopping point, called a base case, so it does not keep asking forever.\n• For example, to count down from three, say three, then ask yourself to count down from two, then one, then stop."}
